authority: Tenn. Comp. R. & Regs. 1540-01-01, promulgated by the Tennessee Higher Education Commission under T.C.A. §§ 49-4-704, 49-7-164 and 49-8-104
verified_by: Rule text of 1540-01-01-.03 and -.06 read in full on this date; every clause encoded below is quoted from it.

volatility.note: Chapter 1540-01-01 was read in full on 2026-07-28. Tennessee classifies on domicile alone; confirm with the institution's registrar for the term being claimed.

capabilities.reason: Tennessee classifies on domicile and states NO durational period, so there is no waiting clock for PathWise to run — the absence is the rule, not a gap in the pack. Two things are deliberately not modelled. The presumption at 1540-01-01-.06(1) that a full-time student does not acquire domicile is rebuttable 'by clear and convincing evidence', which is a judgment on the whole record rather than a condition that can be evaluated from a timeline, so it is stated and never applied automatically. And the chapter contains no provision at all about immigration status or the capacity of non-citizens to establish domicile, so this pack states no such gate — PathWise does not know what Tennessee would decide for an F-1 student and does not pretend to.

construction_rules.note: Every person having his domicile in this State shall be classified 'in-state'; every person not having his or her domicile in this State shall be classified 'out-of-state'.
The domicile of an unemancipated person is that of his or her parent.
The domicile of a married person shall be determined independent of the domicile of the spouse.

Unless the contrary appears from clear and convincing evidence, it shall be presumed that an emancipated person does not acquire domicile in this State while enrolled as a full-time student at any public or private higher education institution in this State.

A person does not gain or lose Tennessee resident status for reason of his presence in any state or county while a member of the armed forces of the United States, or while attending a college or university in any other state.
